import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('worker bundle', () => {
  it('flags a hardcoded file:/// URL', () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });

  it('still flags a real one in the body', () => {
    const url = new URL('file:///Users/example/after-description.js');
    expect(url.protocol).toBe('file:');
  });
});
